lead.title: RTX Pro 5500 Blackwell lands with 84GB of GDDR7 for one-pool local LLMs
lead.summary: NVIDIA listed the RTX Pro 5500 Blackwell Workstation Edition with 21,760 CUDA cores - the same GB202 core count as the GeForce RTX 5090 - plus 84GB of ECC GDDR7 at roughly 1,400 GB/s on a 448-bit interface. The trade is capacity over bandwidth: 28 clamshell GDDR7 chips double the memory of the 5090, which keeps 1,790 GB/s on 512-bit. MIG support means the 84GB can run as one pool for 70B-plus models or split into two isolated 42GB instances.

top_stories.title: llama.cpp 0.4.1 adds Maple 20B-A1B, Tencent Hy 4 and Spark2.5 support
top_stories.summary: Stable release with better JSON-schema handling, chat parsing and server child-process management, a ggml bump to v0.24.0, and a new --fuse-qkv flag in nightlies b10969/b10970.

top_stories.title: Ollama 0.34.0 serves local models straight inside ChatGPT Desktop
top_stories.summary: Adds OpenAI-compatible client tool search, response compaction and faster structured output on Apple Silicon, with no breaking steps for existing Compose or Modelfile setups.

top_stories.title: Temporal raises $550M Series E at a $12.55B valuation
top_stories.summary: Lightspeed-led round with Wellington, Goldman Sachs Alternatives and Tiger Global co-leading; durable execution infrastructure for agentic workloads, with OpenAI, Snap, Nvidia and JPMorgan Chase as customers.

top_stories.title: NVIDIA open-sources OSMO, one YAML across RTX, GB200 and Jetson AGX Thor
top_stories.summary: Apache-2.0 Kubernetes-native orchestrator that routes training, Isaac Sim and hardware-in-the-loop tasks over the KAI Scheduler with NVLink topology-aware placement and per-group timeouts.

items.title: When agents slow down: an Elo-per-token read on test-time strategies
items.summary: Normalises agent accuracy by tokens spent across revision, tool use and stop decisions, giving a directly usable efficiency measure for latency- and VRAM-constrained local agent setups.

items.title: Creative exploration for vibe-design agents gets its own scaffold
items.summary: Separates exploration from implementation in natural-language-to-UI agents so candidate interfaces diversify without the blunt effect of raising token-level temperature, while syntax-sensitive code stays stable.

items.title: Omni-Streaming Thinking fixes premature cross-modal commitment
items.summary: Identifies a failure mode where an early visual interpretation persists after contradicting audio arrives, and updates commitments as video chunks and synchronized audio are processed.

items.title: Learned poison-set selection strengthens LLM backdoors
items.summary: Random sampling of a fixed number of poisoned examples underestimates worst-case vulnerability; across three LLaMA-3-8B settings, learned selection beats random at equal budget.

items.title: Atria Dawn previews an agentic foundation model for research work
items.summary: A foundation agentic language model trained through a verified pipeline for scientific and engineering workflows, where agents also take part in developing their successors.

items.title: Edge0-35B-A3B-preview: 35B MoE in under 3 GiB via SSD expert streaming
items.summary: A 35B mixture-of-experts checkpoint (~3B active per token) shipped as 4-bit with LoRA and prerouter adapters; weights stay on disk and only the needed experts are streamed, so the full model fits phone-class memory budgets. Apache-2.0 safetensors on the Qwen3.5 MoE line.

items.title: colibri: a pure-C inference engine for frontier MoE models
items.summary: Number one on GitHub trending today: a dependency-free C engine that runs 744B to 2.8T parameter MoE models on consumer and heterogeneous hardware by treating storage, RAM and VRAM as one inference hierarchy and streaming experts from disk.

items.title: Agnes-3.0-Flash lands on the Hub as a 33B multimodal checkpoint
items.summary: Image-text-to-text open-weight release added to the trending list on 2026-09-14.

items.title: VoiceStudio: a fully-local ElevenLabs-style voice stack
items.summary: Open-source alternative covering voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation and transcription; +2,776 stars today.

items.title: Pi-box ships a coding agent as a VM inside WASM inside Electron
items.summary: Self-contained local coding agent packaged as an Electron app, with the agent running in a WASM-hosted VM; repository is open source.

items.title: AgenticOS is an open-source control plane for company AI agents
items.summary: Show HN launch of a control plane for coordinating multiple AI agents, with the code published on GitHub.

items.title: VideoHighlighter analyzes video offline and self-hosted
items.summary: Show HN utility that runs without external API dependencies.

items.title: n8n Assistant is live for Cloud and self-hosted Docker installs
items.summary: The Assistant plans, builds, runs and debugs workflows from plain-language prompts on the canvas, asks for credentials only when needed and gates activation behind user approval; still in preview, with plan AI credits separate from Gateway credits.

items.title: n8n idempotency keys: which primitives actually dedupe retries
items.summary: Keys are effectively undeclared, so operators should reuse one key per retried operation, cap retries and verify a webhook delivery ID first; the practical primitives are execution.id as stable identifier, the Data table node as a dedup log and Error Trigger for failed runs.

items.title: Perplexity Portable Computer reaches Windows on 24GB-plus RTX cards
items.summary: The local-first agentic Portable Computer now runs on GeForce RTX and RTX PRO hardware after Linux and DGX Spark, with acceleration requiring at least 24GB of VRAM.

items.title: Arm opens an AI Portal for on-device agentic AI across CPUs, GPUs and NPUs
items.summary: The portal publishes pre-optimized Qwen, Gemma and YOLO builds with latency, memory and size data for ExecuTorch, LiteRT and ONNX-RT, and points to Arm CSS for Mobile 2 running models on SME2 and GPU neural accelerators.

items.title: NVIDIA and Palantir ship a sovereign AI stack that runs on-premises
items.summary: Pairs NVIDIA Nemotron open models with Palantir Foundry, AIP and Ontology for on-prem, colocation or cloud deployment, using cuOpt, NeMo Data Libraries and NeMo AutoModel for optimization and scenario planning.
